Will Jake Paul be Trump's next Press Secretary?

Amazon has now deployed over 1 million robots across its operations, raising concerns about the future of its 1.5 million human workers.
Officials warn the public not to be alarmed by helicopters, emergency vehicles, & simulated gunfire at the U.S. Capitol tomorrow as part of a routine training exercise.
Rep. Ilhan Omar demands the return of her phone & passport seized during an FBI raid on her Washington, DC home.
NASA's James Webb Space Telescope detects a mysterious infrared light signal emanating from a seemingly empty void in space, leaving scientists puzzled.
Florida teen charged after allegedly using an AI-altered Instagram post to falsely implicate her ex-boyfriend in a school shooting threat.

Ukrainian President Zelenskyy requests an additional $79 billion from the European Union to fight Russia in 2027.

Anthropic is reportedly offering Blackstone returns exceeding 10% to help finance its latest AI chip deal.

Kamala Harris calls for expanding the U.S. Supreme Court beyond its current 9 justices & reforming the Electoral College.
Justin Bieber officially crowned 2026 “White Boy of the Year”
Hacker steals personal data belonging to millions of California students, including names, birth dates, home addresses, & disability status, state officials confirm.
Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico compares his campaign to the biblical David fighting Goliath.
Anthropic signs a lease for its first Canadian data center in Nova Scotia.

President Trump waives major Russia sanctions and tariffs under the Lindsey Graham Act just days before they were set to take effect.
Anthropic has reportedly pitched its own AI safety legislation to Congress to regulate themselves.
